question: Which of the following are present only in plant cells?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plastids**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plant and algal cells** contain plastids, which are double-membrane organelles.
 
• **Plastids **are in charge of food production and storage. These frequently contain photosynthetic pigments as well as other pigments that can modify the colour of the cell.
 
• Many plants are descended from plastids from a single parent.
 
• Many gymnosperms inherit plastids from male pollen, whereas angiosperms inherit plastids from female gametes.
 
• Only one parent provides plastids to algae. **Plastid DNA **appears to be completely uniparental in inheritance.
 
• The inheritance of plastid appears to be more irregular during hybridization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Plant cells** are eukaryotic cells that differ from other eukaryotic organisms in numerous fundamental ways.
 
• **The Golgi apparatus** is in charge of transporting, altering, and packaging proteins and lipids into vesicles so that they can be delivered to specific locations.
 
• **A nucleus **is a structure in all plant cells that stores DNA and serves as the cell's command centre.
 
• **The mitochondrion **is around to oval-shaped organelle found in nearly all eukaryotic organisms' cells.
